POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
HONG KONG,

8th March, 1930.

Dear Mr. Alers,

I am in receipt of your
letter of the 25th February. I have nothing of
importance to add to my letter of 11th February to
Mr. Steece.

Mr. Gernsberger did not
come to notice during his stay in Hong Kong. He
appears to have been a little stock-broker while
here.

Yours faithfully,
[Signature]

R. C. Alers, Esq.,
Director of Criminal Investigation,
SHANGHAI.

pages.en:
SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL Fred. W. Gensburger

A confidential report has been received
from the French police that sometime between
5 p.m. and 7 p.m. on July 8, 1929 F.W. Gensberger,
the owner of motor car No. 1926, stopped his car
near Rue Lafayette, French Concession. He then
met two foreign school girls aged about 11 and 12
years respectively who were playing on the road
with bicycles. Gensberger took one of the girls
into a nearby latrine and attempted to rape her.
The girl's companion immediately ran away and
informed a school mistress, who notified the French
police as soon as possible, but before their arrival
on the scene, Gensberger who had attempted to get
away in a car which failed to start, made good
his escape leaving his car on the road which was
taken by the French police to the station.

At 8.30 p. m. same date Gensberger reported
to the Central Police Station that his car had been
stolen from the stand in the International Settlement,
he also notified the French police of the alleged loss.
pages.zh:
绝密及机密 Fred. W. Gensburger

收到法国警方的一份机密报告，称1929年7月8日下午5时至7时之间，车牌号为1926的汽车车主 F.W. Gensberger 在法租界拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）附近停车。随后，他遇见了两名正在路上骑自行车玩耍的外国女学生，年龄分别约为11岁和12岁。Gensberger 将其中一名女孩带入附近的厕所并企图强奸她。女孩的同伴立即跑开并通知了一位女教师，后者尽快向法国警方报案，但在警方到达现场之前，Gensberger 试图驾驶一辆无法启动的汽车逃离，最终成功逃脱，将其汽车留在路上，该车辆被法国警方带往警局。

同日晚上8点30分，Gensberger 向中央巡捕房报案，称其汽车在国际公共租界的停车处被盗，他还就所谓的失窃案通知了法国警方。

POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
HONG KONG.

November 12th, 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to request you kindly
to furnish me with any available information
or official record concerning a man named F.M.
Gensburger, who has recently arrived here from
Shanghai, where I understand he was formerly in
business as a Sharebroker.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

J King
Captain Superintendent of Police.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.
